measures: distance to an object, laser background suppression
source: ifm datasheet O5D100 (O5DLCPKG/US): measuring range 0.03...2 m on 90 % white target, background suppression up to 20 m, 2 complementary switching outputs (NO/NC), IO-Link 1.1 DeviceID 372; no separate setting range is given so the measuring range is used; drawing 18.2 x 70.3 x 46.8 mm. IODD ifm-000174-20210526-IODD1.1.xml sets SP1 as 5–200 cm, so the switch point is 50–2000 mm.
